review.source: PHEBS-48 moves phebs.thrift.caller.go to claim 1.3.0: the resolver catalog (pack 1.6.0, package-struct-fields-v1) records, in the Thrift member, each named or embedded struct field whose declared type is exactly an admitted Thrift client type, keyed by directory and package clause and resolved through the declaring file's own imports. The direct-syntax scanner uses a projected struct only for a name the scanned file does not declare. A name declared twice in a key, a directory with an over-limit or unparseable client source, and an exhausted bound contribute nothing. gRPC is unchanged.
review.evidence: Cross-file named and embedded client fields resolving with role generated, and a resolver compiled from the same descriptors without the projection finding none; build-tag duplicate declarations, an unparseable importing sibling, the x_test package clause and a locally declared name contributing nothing; a hit bound writing one unsupported status row and no field rows. Run once over real cadence-scip with its dave catalog descriptors: 2,298 files read (44 MB), 13 fully parsed, 9 rows in 0.33 s; calls 0 -> 137, all in the gowrap client/wrappers/thrift/*_generated.go files, no abstentions.
review.security: Existing Caller Map, comparison, report and citation fences retained; the projection names only exact admitted client types and cites the declaring file by path and object ID.
review.steady_state_cost: Catalog build only, and only when the catalog has Thrift client descriptors: one blob read and an imports-only parse per base-lane .go file in the thrift-caller view, and a full parse per file that imports an admitted client package, within separate bounds (50,000 sources, 256 MiB, 25,000 rows). Every catalog is re-materialized once at pack 1.6.0. Nothing per query or sync tick.
